Villagers protest water shortages and quarry pollution

Residents in several Indian villages have organized protests due to a lack of drinking water and the environmental impact of stone quarries. In some areas, the water scarcity has led to long walks for basic needs, prompting pleas for government assistance. Concerns have also been raised about stone quarry operations polluting water bodies and affecting agriculture.
